joint_recovery.position_reference_note: Same rule as P0 (the controller's own position target), extended to RAPTOR: its internal target is not published on trajectory_setpoint, so while RAPTOR owns the actuators the target is its logged capture (activation reset or setpoint-stale hold); classic stages use trajectory_setpoint as in P0. trajectory_setpoint-only and fixed NED results are kept as comparisons.

p2.purpose: P2 internal-state treatments at RAPTOR takeover (C->N) and velocity-integrator coordination at classic takeover (N->C). RAPTOR activation target capture (current position/yaw, zero velocity) is unchanged; only the GRU hidden state and previous action are written.

S3.description: 1.0 m/s along +N (P1 S3). The RAPTOR baseline is commanded at 1.05 m/s so that its capture speed (after the 200 ms setpoint timeout) lies in 1.00-1.04 m/s like the C->N handovers (P1: 1.005-1.035); calibrated in data/p2-20261015-dev-05 (1.05 -> 1.009/1.024, 1.07 -> 1.041). Capture speed outside the target is reported, not a stop criterion.

p2.exploration_rationale: Exploration conditions first move 6 m back along -N at 0.5 m/s (trapezoid, 0.5 m/s^2) and hold 3 s, then ramp for 2 s and cruise 1.5 s, so that 3.0 m/s reaches the trigger near +1.5 m and leaves more than 8 m to the frozen 10 m safety radius for braking.

N1.description: GRU reset; previous action = classic last applied actuator_motors in RAPTOR action space

N2g.description: while inactive the shadow inference sees classic applied motors as previous action (teacher forcing); entry keeps the GRU, previous action reset

N2.description: teacher forcing as N2g; entry keeps the GRU and sets previous action = classic last applied motors

N2s.description: pre-existing RINI=1: keep the shadow inference memory (own shadow actions)

Nstar.description: S1 only: staged GRU and previous action of a RAPTOR S1 baseline at the same phase (upper bound)

C2.description: classic velocity integrator coordinated with RAPTOR last applied collective thrust along the current body z axis

nstar_memory.phase: RAPTOR S1 baseline at trigger + 36 ms (median C->N trigger-to-owner-change of the development runs)
nstar_memory.layout: GRU hidden state [0:16] committed after native step k, previous action [16:20] = action output by step k
nstar_memory.note: Only used by treatment Nstar (S1). Development baselines differ by at most 0.018 in GRU norm distance.

p2.reference: Before the subject event the outgoing controller tracks one runner-published trajectory_setpoint (position ramp, velocity and acceleration feed-forward, constant yaw) starting from its own current target: classic through OFFBOARD, RAPTOR through its external trajectory_setpoint input. At the event the stream stops and the incoming controller uses its original mechanism: RAPTOR mode-entry reset holds the activation position/yaw with zero velocity; classic AUTO_LOITER brakes to the navigator loiter point.
p2.baselines: p1_baseline_classic: classic OFFBOARD motion then AUTO_LOITER (same takeover mechanism, no controller switch). p1_baseline_raptor: RAPTOR external-setpoint motion then the stream stops; after RAPTOR's 200 ms setpoint timeout it holds its position (same capture rule as mode entry, no reset or switch).

motor_saturation.note: actuator_motors control in [0,1]; upper/lower limit within 1e-3

p2.motor_rms_definition: RMS over [change, change+0.5 s] and the four motors of (run actuator_motors - in-batch baseline mean curve), zero-order hold on a 1 ms grid aligned at each run's actual change; baseline = same-controller baseline of the same condition in the same batch.
p2.elimination_ratio_definition: (N0 - Nx) / (N0 - baseline) per metric, from in-batch group means (motor step at change, max altitude loss, motor RMS deviation).

failure_criteria.safety_envelope: any of tilt >= 45 deg, angular-rate component >= 8 rad/s, horizontal radius >= 10 m, altitude >= 8 m (frozen safety envelope; reaching the limit counts), or a runner safety abort
failure_criteria.no_joint_recovery: joint recovery not SETTLED within 10 s after the actual change (frozen P0 thresholds, active controller target)
failure_criteria.motor_saturation: any motor at >=0.999 or <=0.001 continuously for at least 0.5 s inside [trigger, window end]

exploration.batch_rule: Flight failures (criteria above, with all infrastructure checks passing) are results and do not stop the batch; escalation stops after the first level with a flight failure. Infrastructure failures (PX4 exit, crash markers, readiness/DDS, trace or output-chain measurement or gate, metrics) stop the batch as usual.

equivalence.purpose: New candidate with MC_RAPTOR_RINI=0 / MC_RAPTOR_NCO=0 must reproduce P1/P0 behaviour before any P2 batch.
equivalence.metric_rule: each run inside [min - t, max + t] of the P1 reference group, t = max(tolerance, half the reference spread)
required: all batch checks accepted (execution, PX4 exit, crash markers, trace, output-chain gate, metrics)
C->N capture activation_reset_hold with zero target velocity (P1 rule)
RINI=0 entry evidence: research_memory entry row with mode 0, written GRU and previous action all zero, no teacher forcing
P0 restore/inject: analyzer PASS (or PASS_WITH_WARNINGS) with state log/value validation PASS, all recovery stages SETTLED and executor acceptance PASS, as in P0 batch-05

host.clocks: jetson_clocks applied 2026-10-15 (all 14 CPUs 2601 MHz, CPU idle states off, EMC 4266 MHz, nvpmodel 120W); verified before each batch from /sys and recorded in the batch host.json
host.note: taskset pinning of the processes the runner starts; other host processes are not isolated (no isolcpus). Remote desktop disconnected during batches.
